---
name: Bug
about: A command of ois-validator crashes, writes something wrong, or reports something the specification does not say
title: ""
labels: bug
---

## Version and command

Output of `ois-validator --version` and the exact command you ran (`ois-validator`, `ois-junit`,
`ois-intent`, `ois-record`, `ois-passport` or `ois-coverage`).

## Input

The smallest document, record, YAML file or JUnit XML report that shows it. Remove anything
confidential.

## What happened and what you expected

The reports or error you got, and the reports the specification or a conformance fixture
leads you to expect.
